description: This file declares external functions related to patching the RTL826XB PHY hardware component, including functions for applying patches to individual ports, broadcasting patches, and initializing patch data structures. It contains include directives for different environment configurations and provides function prototypes with detailed documentation.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch
methods.description: Applies patch data to a specific PHY port, identified by unit, base port, and port offset.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_broadcast_patch
methods.description: Broadcasts patch data to PHY ports with options for per-chip or per-bus mode.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch_db_init
methods.description: Initializes the patch database for a given unit and port.
